SPARK will attend DTF Conference 2026 in Malta

13-14 October 2026

The SPARK team will attend DTF Conference 2026 at Valletta Gateway Terminal, joining discussions on the transition from shore power to integrated energy systems.

The team will deliver a keynote presentation introducing SPARK's offshore charging concept and the project's pilot activities in Skagen.
